# Bid the feeder, the circuits, and the utility.

> Price a 100A to 200A electrical panel or service upgrade from feeder feet, circuit landing, AFCI/GFCI, underground vs overhead, grounding, meter socket, and temporary power — not a published price per amp. See the walk-away number before you match a cheaper panel-swap quote.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
